items.stem:
For a pickle maker in Agra, the cost of making x items is C(x) = x²/10 + 10x + 800 rupees.
(i) What is the fixed cost? (ii) Find the marginal cost C′(x). (iii) Find the marginal cost when 50 items are made. (iv) Interpret your answer to (iii).
items.answer: (i) ₹800 (ii) C′(x) = x/5 + 10 (iii) ₹20 (iv) making one more item after 50 costs about ₹20
items.markingKey: (i) C(0) (1). (ii) derivative term by term (1). (iii) substitute (1). (iv) rate of change of cost (1).

items.stem:
Kabir rolls a ball down a slope. The distance travelled is s(t) = 4t² + 2t metres after t seconds.
(i) Find the average velocity between t = 3 s and t = 3.1 s. (ii) Write [s(3 + h) − s(3)]/h in simplest form. (iii) Find the instantaneous velocity at t = 3 s. (iv) Find the velocity at any time t.
items.answer: (i) 26.4 m/s (ii) 26 + 4h (iii) 26 m/s (iv) v(t) = 8t + 2 m/s
items.markingKey: (i) [s(t₂) − s(t₁)]/(t₂ − t₁) (1). (ii) expand and divide by h (1). (iii) let h → 0 (1). (iv) s′(t) from first principles (1).
